title: Business groups
countsDescription: Derived from visible plugins. Drag plugins here, or press Alt+M on a plugin. Group order is personal.

dialog.sharedDescription: This changes each plugin’s native group attribute. A new group requires its first plugin; empty groups are not saved.
dialog.name: Group name

validation.length: Use 1–32 characters, excluding leading/trailing spaces and control characters.
validation.duplicate: A group with this name already exists. Choose another name.
validation.firstPlugin: Choose the first editable plugin. Empty groups cannot be saved.

readOnly.system: System-shipped definitions have a fixed business group, even for administrators.
readOnly.builtinSkill: Built-in Skill definitions, including their group, are read-only even for administrators.
readOnly.admin: Only administrators can edit these native settings.
readOnly.catalog: Unconfigured catalog entries are read-only. Install/configure the service before changing its group.

errors.missing: The plugin or group is no longer visible. Refresh the list before trying again.
errors.readOnlyMembers: This whole-group operation is blocked by read-only members: {{items}}
errors.write: Could not save this plugin’s group.
errors.partial: Saved {{succeeded}}; failed {{failed}}. Successful changes are not rolled back.
errors.refresh: The native list could not be refreshed. It may be stale; refresh before another change.

drag.sourceLabel: {{name}}. Press Alt+M to move to a business group.
drag.reorderHint: Drag, or use Up/Down to change your personal group order.
drag.orderPlaced: Personal group order updated. No plugin attributes changed.
